function: Full tripod sled: calibrated kite ribs engage the Apollo fan's base slots; blind printed 1/4-20 socket beneath the balance point mates any camera tripod

fits.feature: kite rib into tapered base slot

principal_load: fan weight + tripod clamp preload, along -Z through the thread; lateral hand nudges in XY
assumptions: slot width at its very front end is 4.0 mm (not yet measured)
fan balance point ~ half the box depth on the centerline
uniform 10 mm slab replaces the spec's plate+boss for support-free printing
